obligations: Preserve copyright 2026 Colby Mchenry and the MIT notice when redistributing upstream packages or substantial source.
Keep upstream parser and storage implementations external; this adapter does not claim ownership of them.

ownedBoundary: Rust CLI and source-read-only MCP transport for an optional replaceable semantic engine
Repository snapshot, regular-source containment, provider identity and database binding
Persisted provider-neutral A04 admission with advisory/partial/unknown semantics and no engineering facts
Independent native CodeNexus baseline; no default DAG or authoritative gate takeover

operationTrace.operation: explicit index/sync and snapshot-bound semantic reads

implementationIdentity.activation: explicit optional CLI invocation; reviewed 1.6.2 with minimum stable 1.6.2; launcher/runtime/SDK/CLI/package identity, not all transitive bytes

benefit.metric: semantic CLI operations exercised by real upstream conformance
benefit.unit: operations; not a performance or recall improvement

cost.unit: modules; excludes existing shared infrastructure and external engine

update.policy: Re-review maintenance/license/security and run the real reviewed-version three-platform contracts before changing SDK transport, cache semantics or the version floor. Newer eligible engines are not automatically downgraded. Functional conformance is not a full dependency audit or a measured speed/recall gain.

ownedModifications.description: Optional CLI entry, shared snapshot-bound execution and A04 evidence admission
Trusted version-aware cross-platform launcher and fixed official SDK transport
Ignored binding, lock, database/WAL fingerprints and persisted payload
Actual upstream inventory and explicit file reads constrained to hashed regular sources
Public optional-provider route alongside existing provider contracts
Repository-pinned get_code_context query handler; cannot request writes or redirect repository
Closed source-read-only get_code_context descriptor with explicit local-artifact effects
Public failures and real upstream source/edge/staleness/scope transition conformance

rollback.strategy: Stop explicit CodeGraph calls or omit get_code_context; native CodeNexus and committed-run gates remain independent. Keep content-addressed evidence referenced by admission. No source migration, default DAG switch or main release is part of this deployment.

exit.strategy: Replace the external engine behind the Rust-owned evidence boundary after equivalent real conformance; do not fork parsers/storage merely to rename the provider.
replacementCriteria: Snapshot-bound source containment and explicit cache mutation
Preserved raw provenance, ambiguity, confidence and truncation
Provider-neutral A04 advisory/partial/unknown semantics without invented engineering facts
Three-platform actual engine contracts and independent native CodeNexus fallback

triggers: An approved replacement preserves the owned boundary with lower demonstrated cost

provenance.recordedBy: code-intel engineering assistant; owner-approved selective adaptation and isolated CI deployment
